name: motion-three-layers
title: Primary / Secondary / Ambient
description: Vai chính di chuyển rõ, vai phụ đáp lại nhỏ hơn và trễ, nền trôi chậm liên tục.

moworks.notes: Hero square moves 110 px in 600 ms expo.out; a secondary dot answers 150 ms later, moving 30 px in 550 ms power2.out (recipe: +100 ms at 40 % of the hero); 14 small background dots drift right all the time at 8–16 px/s, wrapping (recipe: a constant 6 s cycle). Both return after an 800 ms hold. Rule: at most 2–3 things move at once. Params: hero (0.6 s) · secondary delay (0.15 s) · amount (40 %) · bg drift (8–16 px/s). Rule: at most two or three things move at once.
